shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs to Crush COD Mobile
shortIntro.para1: Call of Duty Mobile is one of the most polished and action-packed shooters on mobile. To dominate multiplayer matches and battle royale without annoying lags, your phone or tablet needs to meet certain minimum and recommended specs.
shortIntro.para2: Low-end devices can struggle at 25–30 FPS with basic graphics, while mid-range and flagship devices can push 60–120 FPS or even more if your device loves smooth buttery gameplay.

intro: Here’s the official and community-tested minimum and recommended hardware required to run COD Mobile like a pro on Android devices.

minimum.RAM: 2GB minimum (yes, it works, but expect choppy firefights)
minimum.CPU: Snapdragon 429 / Helio P22 / Kirin 655 or equivalent
minimum.Storage: At least 4GB free (updates will need more!)

recommended.Internet: Low-ping 4G/5G or Wi-Fi for flawless multiplayer

ios_intro: iPhone and iPad users, here’s what you need to avoid lag, crashes, and ghost bullets in COD Mobile.

ios_recommended.title: Storage
ios_recommended.value: 6GB free recommended (trust us, you’ll need it)

faqIntroText: Here are the top FAQs about COD Mobile performance, FPS modes, and device support:

faqList.question: Can COD Mobile run on 2GB RAM?
faqList.answer: Yes, but expect low graphics and capped FPS. Smooth performance starts at 4GB.

faqList.question: Does COD Mobile support 120 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, but only on high-end Snapdragon flagships and some newer iPhones.

faqList.question: Do I need a fast internet connection?
faqList.answer: Absolutely! 5–15 Mbps with low ping keeps you alive in multiplayer. Lag = instant death.

faqList.question: Will COD Mobile heat my phone?
faqList.answer: On low-end devices, it might get warm. High-end devices handle it well, but using high FPS + max graphics will toast any device eventually 😉.
